personality.description: This person tends to plan ahead carefully, keep routines orderly, and check details before acting. They are open to some new ideas or experiences, but usually prefer changes that feel manageable and do not disrupt stability. In moral dilemmas, they stay calm, weigh the facts and consequences carefully, and try to reach a fair conclusion without getting overly emotional. In group discussions, they speak in a measured, concise way, listen more than they talk, and become firm and clear when they believe an important point needs to be defended.
